# Deepbionics

> Academic profile and research website of Prof. Dr. Michael C. Thrun, focused on decision support systems, explainable artificial intelligence, machine learning, knowledge discovery and interdisciplinary data science.

Canonical site: https://mthrun.github.io/
Primary language: English
Last updated: 2026-08-01

## Core pages

- [Profile and overview](https://mthrun.github.io/): Research profile, academic role, applied research and technology transfer.
- [Research and projects](https://mthrun.github.io/projects.html): Decision support systems, explainable AI, knowledge discovery, forecasting, clustering and interdisciplinary applications.
- [Open-source software](https://mthrun.github.io/rpackages.html): R packages for visualization, clustering, classification, forecasting, distribution analysis and reproducible data science.
- [Teaching](https://mthrun.github.io/lectures.html): University teaching and course materials in artificial intelligence, machine learning, knowledge discovery and temporal data mining.
- [Publications](https://mthrun.github.io/publications.html): Complete chronological publication list with DOI links where available.
- [Contact](https://mthrun.github.io/contactme.html): Academic collaborations, talks, teaching, software and applied-research enquiries.

## Research themes

- Decision support systems in medicine, science, business and industry.
- Explainable and human-in-the-loop artificial intelligence.
- Machine learning, classification, clustering and high-dimensional data analysis.
- Knowledge discovery, visualization and self-organizing swarm intelligence.
- Time-series forecasting and decision-oriented evaluation.
- Interdisciplinary research in medicine, life sciences, environmental science, archaeology, economics and industrial analytics.

## Citation guidance

Use DOI links on the publication and project pages as the authoritative source for individual scholarly works. Medical AI projects are decision-support systems and do not replace integrated expert diagnosis. Commercial project descriptions may be limited by confidentiality agreements.
